call_points.text: The company plans to open 150 showrooms across Kalyan, Candere and the new regional brand during FY27.
Management aims to make the India operations entirely non-GML debt-free during the current financial year, possibly by H1 FY27.
Long-term same-store sales growth (SSSG) for projection purposes is recommended at 10%, despite recent higher trends.

guidance.statement: We plan to open 150 showrooms across Kalyan, Candere and the new regional brand during FY27.
FY27 PBT margin to be held at FY26 level on a conservative basis
Recycled gold share of revenue to be maintained at 55-60%
84 Kalyan showrooms in India and 50 Candere stores to be opened in FY27
Non-GML debt to be fully repaid by end-September 2026

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Durables > Gems, Jewellery And Watches

operating_notes.text: Kalyan Jewellers reached 507 showrooms across India, UK, USA and the Middle East as of May 2026.
Candere turned PAT positive in H2 FY26 with mid-30s gross margins due to >70% studded jewellery share.
Recycled gold was over 46% of Q1FY27 revenue and over 55% in June, with a target band of 55-60%.
Old-gold exchange is margin dilutive by 0.2-0.3% versus cash sale, where a 0.5-0.75% markup on spot is earned.
Customs-duty gain was about ₹40 Cr in Q1 and is expected at about ₹60 Cr in Q2, with none in Q3.

holders.name: Sundaram Mutual Fund A/C Sundaram Mid Cap Fund

timeline.summary: T S Kalyanaraman, as promoter, declared no new encumbrances on Kalyan Jewellers India Limited shares beyond prior pledges by Mr. T.K. Ramesh and Mr. T.K. Seetharam (161,326,883 shares) on **2026-04-20** under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹10,274.94 Cr (+66.2% YoY), net profit ₹409.5 Cr (+118.3% YoY).
Kalyan Jewellers reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹10,275 Cr (+66% YoY) and PAT of ₹410 Cr (+118% YoY).
Kalyan Jewellers India Limited’s **Jishnu RG** shared the earnings conference call recording for Q4 & FY 2025-26 on May 8, 2026, via its website.
Kalyan Jewellers reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹10,275 Cr (+66% YoY) and PAT of ₹410 Cr (+118% YoY), and outlined plans to add 150 showrooms in FY27.
Kalyan Jewellers' Q1FY27 call (4 Aug 2026) reported 38% consolidated revenue growth to ₹10,008 Cr; PBT margin of 5.1%; and non-GML debt repayment targeted by end-September.
